name: Grablings
summary:
**The multiverse is up for grabs!**

Players become Grablings, interdimensional creatures who live for mischief and chaos. Their prime purpose in life is to have fun and wreak havoc across the multiverse, which they consider their ultimate playground.

# Paint 'n Seek!

In their first adventure, the Grablings play silly games of hide and seek. Hiders paint themselves into wacky environments to avoid getting found, and the seeker(s) aim to win by finding all hidden Grablings!
